item.title: 🎃 Halloween: The Game — New Post
item.dc:creator: @HalloweenTVG
item.description:
Halloween: The Game (@HalloweenTVG)

The people of Haddonfield will never forget Halloween night, 1978...

We're excited to showcase the talented voice cast of Halloween: The Game, whose performances help bring 'The Night He Came Home' to life like never before.

Starting with the OG Shape himself, Nick Castle (@ncastlez), who once again embodies the Boogeyman, Michael Myers.
